opennyai_summary.21_June_2023__facts:
The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in a case registered under Sections 323, 341, 379, 498A and 420/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section  of Dowry Prohibition Act.
Allegation against the petitioner is of committing torture upon the victim due to non-fulfillment of demand of dowry.
opennyai_summary.21_June_2023__arguments:
There is no allegation of tampering of witnesses alleged against the petitioner.
The petitioner has falsely been implicated in the present case due to petty family dispute.
The petitioner has relied upon the judgment of this Court in the case of Md. Naimul Haque Ansari @ Naimul Haque Ansari & Ors. Vs. The State of Bihar, reported in 2006(3) PLJR 182.
opennyai_summary.21_June_2023__decision:
The case is triable by the Magistrate.
Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, let the petitioner, above named, in the event of arrest/surrender before the Dilip Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/107663186/
1 learned court below within a period of twelve weeks from today, be released on anticipatory bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/- (Ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the Court below/concerned Court in connection with Complaint Case No. 1141 of 2021 (Patna City), subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
The petitioner is directed to co-operate during the trial.
If the petitioner does not co-operate during the trial, the Court below will be at liberty to cancel the bail bonds of the petitioner.
If so advised, either of the parties will be at liberty to make an application before the Court below for referring the matter to the District Mediation Centre for the purpose of reconciliation or one time settlement.
In case, any such application is made by either of the parties, the Court below shall refer the matter to the District Mediation Centre.
